name: Scalloped Potatoes
notes: Served at Tess and Paul’s Wedding Open House in Soulsbyville, and declared delicious!

items: 1 small onion, peeled and thinly sliced
4 pound Yukon gold potatoes (others work too), sliced into ⅛” rounds
1 (of 2) cups fresh grated sharp cheddar cheese

steps.title: Sauté the onion
steps.body: Melt **3 Tbsp butter** in a large sauté pan over med-high heat. Add and sauté for 4–5 minutes: **1 small onion**, peeled and thinly sliced.

steps.title: Add the garlic
steps.body: Add and sauté for an additional 1–2 minutes, til fragrant: **4 large cloves garlic**, minced.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.body: Stir in, until evenly combined: **¼ cup flour**. Cook for one minute, then gradually whisk in: **1 cup chicken stock**, **2 cups milk**, **1½ tsp salt**, **½ tsp black pepper** and **1 tsp thyme**.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.body: Continue cooking 1–2 minutes until the sauce just begins to simmer around the edges of the pan and thickens (don’t let it boil). Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.title: Slice the potatoes
steps.body: Slice, into ⅛” rounds: **4 pound Yukon gold potatoes** (others work too).

steps.title: Layer the first half
steps.body: In a greased 9×13 baking dish, place half the sliced potatoes in an even layer. Top with half the cream sauce, then sprinkle with **1 (of 2) cups fresh grated sharp cheddar cheese** and **½ cup fresh-grated Parmesan cheese**.

steps.title: Repeat the layers
steps.body: Repeat layers of potato, cream sauce, and sharp cheddar cheese.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.body: Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes at 400°F.

steps.title: Bake uncovered
steps.body: Then remove foil and bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes more, until potatoes are cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: To serve, sprinkle with **1 tsp thyme** and additional Parmesan.
